Map · Mute · Pause
MNEsc
Controller (Xbox or PlayStation): left stick move; on a ship up raises sails, down lowers them, left/right turn · right stick aim (limited reach) · RT / R2 attack or fire · LT / L2 ranged or special · A / Cross use · B / Circle leave ship or dismount · X / Square whistle · Y / Triangle tonic · LB / L1 switch ranged or special · RB / R1 switch melee · L3 sprint · d-pad up/down zoom · View / Share map · Menu / Options pause. In menus: d-pad or stick to pick, A / Cross to select, B / Circle to go back. Touch (phone or tablet): left thumb moves, right thumb aims and fires, buttons for the rest; they disappear when a keyboard, mouse or controller is used. Press any button on your controller to connect it.
Play with keyboard and mouse, a controller or touch. Sound on for cannon fire.
